description: Build a Black Friday video ad from one product photo, then add the confirmed offer after download. Choose a scene for social feeds and product pages.
h1: Black Friday Video Ads You Can Post Before the Rush
lead: Place your product photo in a scene, add an AI voice if you want one, then put the price, code, and end date on after download.

steps.d: Upload one sharp photo of the product in the offer. Keep the full shape and finish visible.

faq.q: What does this Black Friday template make?
faq.a: A deal clip from your product photo, with an AI actor, a script, and a voiceover if you want them. You still type the confirmed price, code, and end date after download.

faq.q: How does the scene come together?
faq.a: Upload one product photo, describe the setting, pick a size and a length, then add captions or the offer in the built-in editor.

faq.q: Why not book a shoot for the sale?
faq.a: AI backgrounds build the scene from the photo you have, so you can skip a studio camera and a large set before sale week.
Shops that need a product clip for Black Friday, Cyber Monday, or a later holiday offer, on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, or a product page.

faq.q: Can I do this without editing experience?
faq.a: Yes. The scene is built for you. Add stickers, captions, a track from the music library, or an AI voice in the editor, and put the offer on only after you confirm it.
One sharp photo of the item that is actually in the offer, with the full shape and finish visible. A short clip you have rights to can be uploaded too.

faq.q: Which size and length fit a deal post?
faq.a: 9:16 for Stories and Reels, 1:1 for a square feed, or 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4 when the placement needs them. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Publish to TikTok or Meta from the same project.

faq.q: Does the generator write the discount?
faq.a: No. Add the live price, code, and end date after download. If the offer changes, edit that text instead of trusting an old file.

24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. You see the cost first. A failed job returns its credits. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits, Pro is $35 with 300, and Premium is $63 with 600.

faq.q: Can I use the download in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. It has no watermark. If a person appears, that person is an AI performer, not a shopper who bought the deal.

faq.q: Can I start from a link, a batch, or the API?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a product page link for a script and a cloned voice, run a batch when many products share the sale scene, or send the catalog through the AIVideosUGC API. Another language can reuse the same photo. The offer text is still yours to confirm.
